tasks.goal: Reconcile the current repository, toolchain, original protected files and writer state; write docs/implementation/ADMISSION.md with the actual first-slice build paths, executable checks, native-UI feasibility and next bounded task. Acceptance: original files preserved, no competing writer, concrete commands and limits recorded. No device/account access, toolchain installation or publication. Re-admit later automation against these real checks before running coding tasks.

Implement AppDomain contracts and the smallest buildable shell/CLI foundation described by backlog A01. Acceptance: actual local build, explicit synthetic/source state, independent domain types; native UI only where verified toolchain supports it, otherwise CLI readiness recorded. Do not scaffold future transports or empty packages.

Implement a deterministic synthetic backup generator and expected content manifest for backlog A02. Acceptance: valid small manifest and metadata, plist/SQLite/text/unknown examples, Unicode path and missing payload, repeatable expected hashes. No personal sources or proprietary assets.

Implement fixture BackupCore enumeration and bounded inspection. Acceptance: all manifest rows visible, correct source revision/time and entry kind, missing payload distinct from unknown format, read-only text/hex preview and meaningful path-isolation/source-preservation checks. No USB or encrypted/semantic completeness claims.

Implement exact-selection raw export with source/destination isolation, collision policy and JSON receipts. Acceptance: source unchanged, copied bytes/length verified, per-item missing/error/cancellation results preserved, repeatable CLI or native demo. No phone-space-saved claim or device writes.

Integrate and demonstrate synthetic fixture -> catalogue -> inspection -> export -> verified receipt with the actual available toolchain. Acceptance: exact build/run/check commands, source/output integrity evidence, one complete usable path, concise limitations and next task; native UI/bundle gate remains open if unverified. No product release or real device compatibility claim.
